requirements.requirement: Real semantic-release analysis from existing history
requirements.actualResult: Semantic-release 25.0.9 calculated initial version 1.0.0 from real history without manufacturing release tags. First-release, patch, minor, breaking-change and no-release regressions passed. The downloaded plan digest was independently recomputed.

requirements.requirement: Lockstep package preparation without source-version mutation
requirements.actualResult: Eight audited source packages at 0.1.0 produced eight prepared packages at 1.0.0 with correct internal ranges. All non-manifest contents matched source artifacts byte for byte; source versions and public Node >=22 support remained unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Installed CLI and generated configuration use the prepared version
requirements.verification: tests/release-preparation.test.mjs; prepared and loopback-registry npm/pnpm consumers
requirements.actualResult: Installed CLI output and generated ForgeQA dependencies used 1.0.0, not a compiled 0.1.0 constant. All eight installed public packages matched the prepared version in every consumer receipt.

requirements.verification: Release candidates 36503848112 prepared-acceptance.json and prepared-consumers receipts
requirements.actualResult: Fresh npm/pnpm consumers used the final prepared artifacts and installed CLI. Each passed both demo API/UI cases on first attempt, public TypeScript compilation and native Playwright execution. Tarball and receipt digests were independently verified.

requirements.requirement: Real npm protocol interruption and lost-acknowledgement recovery
requirements.actualResult: Actual npm CLI publication of the prepared set was interrupted after three uploads and resumed to eight unique publications without republishing. Lost-acknowledgement, conflict and failure regressions passed. Acceptance is limited to the owned loopback registry.

Fresh npm and pnpm consumers installed all eight prepared versions from the loopback registry, not tarball paths, and each passed two first-attempt demo cases plus native execution. Matching source/version/checksum receipts and normal registry cleanup were verified. This is not public npm or full registry-installed TeamBoard/LedgerGuard acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Fail-closed explicit public candidate publication path
requirements.actualResult: Workflow/source/scope/OIDC refusal tests passed and the public publishing job was correctly skipped on push. Actual npm authorization and live candidate publication remain unverified; no public release is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Stable promotion remains separate and blocked by incomplete evidence
requirements.actualResult: Partial sets, prereleases and missing or mismatched source/version gates cannot pass stable-promotion checks. No stable dist-tag, source release tag or action alias was changed.
